007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.DatabaseAdmin;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import org.slf4j.Logger;
013import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
014
015import java.util.Arrays;
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for granting Select AI package privileges to database users.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link DatabaseAdmin} client and call
022 * {@link DatabaseAdmin#grantPrivileges(List)}.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by granting required package
025 * privileges to the supplied users. It does not modify network ACL entries.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>This sample requires a database user authorized to perform administrative
028 * setup operations such as package privilege changes, data-access
029 * configuration, or network ACL updates. Do not run administrative samples with
030 * normal application runtime credentials.</p>
031 *
032 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROVIDER_USERS - comma-separated database users</li>
038 * </ul>
039 *
040 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
041 * <pre>{@code
042 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
043 * }</pre>
044 *
045 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
046 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
047 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
048 * <pre>{@code
049 * mvn clean install
050 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
051 * }</pre>
052 *
053 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
054 * <pre>{@code
055 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/databaseadmin/GrantPrivilegesSample.java
056 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin.GrantPrivilegesSample
057 * }</pre>
058 *
059 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
060 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
061 * and diagnostics.</p>
062 */
063public final class GrantPrivilegesSample {
064    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GrantPrivilegesSample.class);
065
066    private GrantPrivilegesSample() {
067    }
068
069    public static void main(String[] args) {
070        List<String> users = parseUsers(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROVIDER_USERS"));
071
072        try (DatabaseAdmin databaseAdmin = createDatabaseAdmin()) {
073            boolean granted = databaseAdmin.grantPrivileges(users);
074
075            System.out.printf("Grant privileges completed: %s%n", granted);
076            System.out.printf("Users: %s%n", users);
077        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
078            LOGGER.error("Failed to grant Select AI privileges for users {}.", users, e);
079        }
080    }
081
082    private static DatabaseAdmin createDatabaseAdmin() throws SelectAIException {
083        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
084                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
085                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
086                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
087                .build();
088
089        return DatabaseAdmin.create(dbConnectionConfig);
090    }
091
092    private static List<String> parseUsers(String value) {
093        List<String> users = Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
094                .map(String::trim)
095                .filter(user -> !user.isEmpty())
096                .toList();
097        if (users.isEmpty()) {
098            throw new IllegalStateException("SELECTAI_PROVIDER_USERS must contain at least one user");
099        }
100        return users;
101    }
102
103    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
104        String value = System.getenv(name);
105        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
106            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
107        }
108        return value;
109    }
110}
